name: SearchField
summary: Text field specialized for search, with clear affordance.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Nothing was confirmed by the snapshot: the focus lands on a text input, where Space types a character and every printable key changes the value — the probe excludes that case (digitaTexto) rather than accusing a correct ficha. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: Enter, Escape. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect — a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph inside the field. Decorative — the accessible name comes from the label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: What can be searched, e.g. "Search components…".

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step. The glyph shrinks with it.

props.name: width
props.description: The field width (A-08): "20rem" or "auto". Without it, 100% of the line as always. `size` changes height and type, never width.
